out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK AT THE DISHWASHING MACHINE IN THE KITCHEN TO NOT HAVE HOT WATER.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PLEASE ENSURE THIS SINK HAS 100F WATER BY AUGUST 25TH.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED HANDWASHING SINK AT THE BAR TO HAVE A STRAINER IN IT.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: STRAINER REMOVED. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN (8): HEAVY CREAM AT 72F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: HEAVY CREAM DISPOSED OF. PIC STATED THEY WILL NOT USE THIS COOLER TO HOLD TCS FOODS SUCH AS DAIRY PRODUCTS.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: OBSERVED EGG OFFERED TO BE SERVED ON BURGERS UNDERCOOKED OR RAW AND NOT MARKED WITH AN ASTERISK. OBSERVED STATEMENT ON THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU MISSING THE DISCLOSURE STATEMENT.
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PLEASE ADD AN ASTERISK TO THE EGG ON THE MENU THAT IS OFFERED WITH BURGERS. CORRECT THE CONSUMER ADVISORY AT THE BOTTOM OF THE MENU TO READ AS FOLLOWS (YOURS IS MISSING THE FIRST SENTENCE): *This item may be served undercooked. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY AUGUST 25TH. Mackenzie's Tunes and Tonics (Inspection Date: 08/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDES AND GOOD-BE-GONE STORED WITH POP CONTAINERS AND LINES IN THE OFFICE. OBSERVED SPRAY BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS STORED ON A CART WITH CLEAN SILVERWARE AND NAPKINS NEAR THE BAR.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: CHEMICALS RELOCATED. RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDES DISPOSED OF.

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. OBSERVED THREE CANS OF RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDE IN THE OFFICE.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. CDI: RESIDENTIAL PESTICIDE DISPOSED OF.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. Handwashing sink by the 1 dr up soda display cooler did not have paper towels accessible
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC replaced the paper towels

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed tin foil being used as a shelf liner in the kitchen without being changed every 24 hrs
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC disposed of tinfoil, agreed to stop use of foil as a shelf liner

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: greasehood lightbulbs observed 5 burned out
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC agreed to repair greasehood

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. Test kit in facility expired in 2024
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PIC agreed to acquire new test kit, will follow up to verify compliance

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Ventilation Filters, Designed to Maintain/Clean
violations.observation: Grease extraction filters in the hood system are not easily removable. Observed filter in the greasehood broken and damaged
violations.corrective_action: Filters or other grease extracting equipment shall be designed to be readily removable for cleaning and replacement if not designed to be cleaned in place. PIC agreed to have the greasehood repaired Mackenzie's Tunes and Tonics (Inspection Date: 02/18/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed heavy whipping cream at 45F in 2 door glass cooler
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC disposed of heavy whipping cream

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food
violations.observation: A review of the menu with the foodservice operator indicates that there is no consumer advisory for the following food item(s) that may be served raw and/or undercooked: eggs served any style on top of burgers
violations.corrective_action: If an animal food such as beef, eggs, fish, lamb, milk, pork, poultry, or shellfish is served or sold raw or undercooked the permit holder shall inform consumers of the significantly increased risk of consuming such foods by way of a disclosure and reminder using brochures, deli case or menu advisories, label statements, table tents, placards, or other effective written means. PIC added consumer advisory and reprinted menus

out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Permit to Operate Required & Posted
violations.observation: The establishment has not posted the permit to operate in a conspicuous location. EHS observed no permit to operate in this location.
violations.corrective_action: A valid permit shall be posted in every food establishment in a conspicuous place in the public view. Food establishment permits are issued for a calendar year and expire on December 31 regardless of the month of issue. PIC agreed to locate permit and follow up in three days with EHS to verify compliance.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: EHS observed raw beef being stored above cooked gumbo and beef stock.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC moved raw beef so it was not above cooked RTE foods

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the 3 compartment sink piping are leaking.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC agreed to have piping repaired
